title: assert
concept: assert checks a condition at runtime and traps if it's false — a lightweight way to verify assumptions in debug builds.
why: assert documents and enforces internal assumptions that aren't part of the public API contract. It catches logic errors during development.
tips: Use assert for internal invariants and sanity checks — things that should ALWAYS be true
assert failures mean there's a logic bug in your code, not bad input from a caller
Add assert messages to explain WHY the condition should hold — helps future maintainers
assert is stripped in release by default — use @llvm.trap for production safety checks
common_mistakes: Using assert to validate external input — that's what requires is for
Putting side effects inside assert — the side effect disappears in release builds
Writing assert(false) for TODO — use @llvm.trap or unimplemented!() instead
